scientific_integrity: The proof uses exact unrestricted Rayleigh bounds, an analytic scalar minimax, a complete Fourier spectrum, and eigenvector equality rigidity. The standalone script reproduces 3910 supplemental finite checks but does not substitute for the infinite-family proof; prior eigenratio frameworks and SLEM wheel calculations were acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Uniform vertex masses; nonnegative independent conductances on W_m; equal unit edge prices; budget B>0; requires connectedness and optimizes unnormalized Laplacian eigenratio. No claims for per-node bounded degree normalization, discrete-time stochastic SLEM, heterogeneous prices or arbitrary graphs. Historical wheel Fourier spectrum and full spectral-gap optimal design are previous work. Exact originality is qualified by possible unindexed equivalent literature.
title: Unique eigenratio-optimal conductances on wheel networks
